text: Walking through these spaces, I sense the hum of intellectual activity. The glass room reveals people in focused discussion, collaborating, learning — their presence palpable even at a distance. Moving on, the bold "R + D" of research and development on the vibrant wall invites curiosity. I feel a mixture of excitement and contemplation, as though on the verge of ideas ready to take flight. In such environments, the boundaries between observer and participant blur, and I am inspired to reflect on how collective knowledge is built, shared, and transformed.
